Post-mortem: empty search spinner done

The fix shipped in PR #42 after one review finding; clearing the search box shows the empty state again.

Outcome

done Tested revision e7d2b10 on PR #42. Fixes B-1 through P-1. No success criteria apply: the bug report's "gone when" lines became J-1.

Timeline

  1. Sweep confirms B-1 and writes a failing test (sweep).
  2. Route approved as D-1.
  3. Build of P-1 at a3f5c18: the guard moves above the loading line; the failing test passes.
  4. Verify and QA round 1 pass; PR #42 opens.
  5. End review raises F-1, a Should-Fix race.
  6. Fix at e7d2b10; QA round 2 passes; PR merges.

Step by step detail: trace (no session captured for this fixture).

How implementation went

P-1. Reused the existing empty state and the investigator's failing test. Created one more test for the late-response race. The change is 11 lines in useSearch.ts and 38 lines of tests, inside the files allowed.

Contributing factors

  • How did the regression ship? The commit that moved setLoading(true) had no test for the empty path.
  • How did it go unnoticed? The empty path is not part of any end-to-end test, and manual checks typed queries but never cleared one.
  • How did the race slip past QA round 1? J-1 cleared the box after results had loaded, so no request was in flight.

Surprises and deviations

  • Original: one change to the guard. Actual: the guard plus an abort of the in-flight request, after F-1.
  • QA used both rounds allowed.

Unexpected issues

A late search response could overwrite the cleared state. It was not in the bug report; the end review raised it and the verifier reproduced it.

Critical decisions

Ignore responses for a query that is no longer current, rather than cancelling requests, because the app has no request-cancel helper today. Taken by the implementer within the files allowed.

Assumptions that were wrong

None.

Thrashing

None.

Verification and review

J-1 pass and S-1 pass at e7d2b10 (verification). One review point, the end review: F-1 fixed (findings). QA rounds: 2 of 2.

Lessons

  • When a journey clears or cancels input, add a step that does it while a request is in flight. Here that would have caught F-1 one round earlier.
  • The investigator's failing test saved the build step a repro: the build took one commit.
